title: The Codex installer replaces everything inside its managed block
body: Re-running `deltadictum install --host codex` rewrites every line between BEGIN and END DD MANAGED CONFIG in .codex/config.toml with the current configBody (in v2 a single comment: DD runs no MCP server), and gives DD's own handlers in .codex/hooks.json the installer's timeout and limits back; handlers DD did not write, their matcher groups, and everything outside the block are kept. Move hand edits out of the block, or run with --dry-run first and diff the files it lists. Why: in a real project (2026-10) regenerating the block dropped a hand-set approval_mode; 0.8.4 preserved tools.* tables only, and v2 drops the MCP block altogether, so any key a person added inside it goes without a warning.
not_derivable: The installer replaces the block silently; a person's edits inside it vanish with no message, which only a real project showed.

evidence.summary: managedBlock replaces the block; owned handlers are refreshed in place.
